name: identityEquivalenceDifferentSizeReturnsFalse
input: UnionType A with 2 alternates, UnionType B with 1 alternate, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because sizes differ under IDENTITY equivalence.

name: structuralEquivalenceDifferentSizeReturnsFalseIfMissingAlternate
input: UnionType A with 2 alternates, UnionType B with 3 alternates, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns false because B contains alternates not present in A.

name: equivalentUnionTypesSameAlternatesReturnsTrue
input: UnionType A and UnionType B with identical sets of alternates, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns true because every alternate in B has an equivalent alternate in A and vice versa.

name: identityEquivalenceSameSizeAndAlternatesReturnsTrue
input: UnionType A and UnionType B with identical alternates and size, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because sizes match and all alternates match via identity.

name: checkUnionEquivalenceHelperMissingAlternateReturnsFalse
input: UnionType A containing {Number}, UnionType B containing {String}, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns false because B has an alternate (String) not found in A.

name: hasAlternateMatchingTypeReturnsTrue
input: UnionType containing {Number, Boolean}, target type = Number, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns true because an alternate matches using the equivalence method.

name: hasAlternateNoMatchingTypeReturnsFalse
input: UnionType containing {Number, Boolean}, target type = String, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns false because no alternate matches the target type.

name: hasAlternateIdentityMismatchReturnsFalse
input: UnionType containing a Number instance, target type = a different Number instance with same value, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false under IDENTITY equivalence if the object instances are distinct.

name: hasAlternateIdentityMatchReturnsTrue
input: UnionType containing a Number instance, target type = the exact same Number instance, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true under IDENTITY equivalence because references are identical.

name: emptyUnionTypesReturnsTrue
input: UnionType A empty, UnionType B empty, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because both have size 0 and empty alternate collections.

name: differentOrderOfAlternatesReturnsTrue
input: UnionType A with {Number, String}, UnionType B with {String, Number}, eqMethod = EquivalenceMethod.STRUCTURAL
expected: Returns true because union equivalence is commutative and order-independent.
